title: saveas
summary: Save a figure to a file.

gpu_support.notes: `saveas` gathers handle, filename, and format metadata only. PNG exports use RunMat's shared plotting renderer; FIG exports serialize the figure scene payload.

tested.integration: figure persistence round-trip and PNG export regression coverage

description: `saveas(fig, filename)` saves the specified figure or graphics object parent figure. RunMat supports RunMat FIG scene files and PNG image export.
behaviors: `saveas(fig, filename)` infers the output format from `.fig` or `.png`; names without an extension save as `.fig`.
`saveas(fig, filename, formattype)` uses the explicit format. If `filename` has no extension, RunMat appends the standard extension for that format.
Figure, axes, text, legend, ruler, and plot-child handles save their parent figure.
PDF, EPS, SVG, JPEG, TIFF, and MATLAB code-generation formats are recognized as unsupported until those exporters exist.

Figure handles are double graphics identities and format/file arguments are text. Direct typed-integer or gpuArray arguments are invalid and reject before file I/O; integer plot data nested inside a figure remains authoritative scene data.
gpu_residency: `saveas` is an I/O sink. It returns a host logical status and does not launch numeric GPU kernels.
gpu_behavior: PNG export uses the same renderer path as `print`.
FIG export serializes plotting state through the replay scene exporter.
Unsupported export formats fail before any partial output is written.
